name: Tablet Computer Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solutions for tablet computer manufacturers, covering display assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The tablet computer production line solution is TXAM's full-line automation solution for tablet computer manufacturers.

Solution Components

The full line covers the entire process including display module assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, cable connection, visual inspection, functional testing, appearance inspection, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision lamination of display modules with accuracy of ±0.1mm
  • Automated battery installation compliant with safety standards
  • Precision motherboard assembly with high placement accuracy
  • AOI visual inspection with accurate defect recognition
  • Full functional testing to ensure product quality
  • Anti-static packaging to ensure product safety

Services

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
